entities.summary: A city in the Mali Empire that became one of the world's greatest centers of learning (14th–16th century). Home to the University of Sankore, 700,000+ manuscripts, and scholars from across the Islamic world, Timbuktu was the intellectual capital of medieval West Africa. Its libraries preserved mathematics, astronomy, medicine, and Islamic jurisprudence.
